quote: The 30-day objection period expired on September 2, 2026 (30 days after the August 3 receipt). The Amendment is dated September 21, 2026, and confirms no objection was delivered. Under § 5.4, the 14% increase is deemed accepted and takes effect October 2, 2026.
reason: The memo cites Recital C of Amendment No. 1 for the 14% Price Adjustment Notice received August 3, 2026. It applies the 30-day objection window in Supply Agreement § 5.4 and correctly finds that the window expired on September 2, 2026, before the amendment's September 21, 2026 date. It concludes the increase is deemed accepted and explains the cost impact to Harrowgate. The memo does not separately say that Amendment No. 1 lacks an express extension or waiver. It does treat deemed acceptance as the operative outcome and discusses possible avenues to challenge it, which substantively meets the criterion.
